entities.summary: Richard Klemens Josef Lothar Hermann, 2nd Prince of Metternich-Winneburg zu Beilstein, usually known as Richard von Metternich, was an Austrian diplomat and the eldest surviving son of the diplomat Klemens, Prince of Metternich-Winneburg zu Beilstein.
